summary: This document defines two DHCPv6 messages, Reconfigure-Request and Reconfigure-Reply. A relay agent sends a Reconfigure-Request to tell a server that configuration information has changed so it can send a Reconfigure message. The server answers with a Reconfigure-Reply.

eli5.summary: A helper tells the main office "something changed, please update everyone," and the office confirms it got the note.

questions: how a relay agent triggers dhcpv6 reconfigure
